definitions.full: H6144. Ar I. עָר proper name, of a location in Moab, south of Arnon ( Ηρ Num 21:15 , elsewhere chiefly Αροηρ ); — ׳ע 21:15 ; Deut 2:9 , 18 , 29 ; מוֺאָד עָר Num 21:28 ; Isa 15:1 ; — usually interpreted as capital city ( עָר = עִיר ) of Moab (DHM ZMG xxxvii (1883), 398 compare Sabean ער fortified height , compare Mordtm Him. Inschr. 29 Hal Ét. Sab. 159 so Arabic , dialect of Yemen); Buhl Geogr.269 f. thinks name of district South of Arnon.
